Bill.BriefDescription: Providing comprehensive membership of significant jurisdictions on the executive board of regional transportation planning organizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing comprehensive membership ofsignificant jurisdictions on the executive board of regionaltransportation planning organizations; and amending RCW 47.80.060.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.80.060 and 2005 c 334 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In order to qualify for state planning funds available to regionaltransportation planning organizations, the regional transportationplanning organizations containing any county with a population inexcess of one million shall provide voting membership on its executiveboard to the state transportation commission, the state department oftransportation, ((and)) the four largest public port districts withinthe region as determined by gross operating revenues, any city in themost populous county that has a population greater than three percentof that county's population, and any city in any other county that hasa population greater than five percent of the population of that countywhere the city is located. It shall further assure that at least fiftypercent of the weighted vote attributable to the county and city local p. 1 HB 2004elected officials who serve on the executive board also serve ontransit agency boards or on a regional transit authority.
